FAQ

Manorama Online Premium subscription is a digital only subscription that gives subscribers unlimited access to all premium and non-premium articles, a distraction free ad-free experience, and access to exclusive newsletters and events. Subscribers can access their premium digital subscription on website, Android and IOS apps.
  • Premium articles: Unlimited access to all premium articles exclusively for you! Read expert opinions, data-driven stories, insightful analyses and more.
  • Ad-free experience: As a premium subscriber, you will see no ads as you browse the website or the app. This means fewer distractions to your reading experience and quicker loading pages. So, grab stories with limited interruptions!
  • Malayala Manorama e-Paper: Get daily access to a replica of the printed paper on your computer, tablet, or smartphone. e-Paper access is, however, only available with a 1-year Manorama Online Premium + epaper subscription plan.
  • Exclusive newsletters: Premium subscribers will receive exclusive newsletters curated with key notes and summaries, ensuring that you stay well-informed and updated about key events and stories.
  • Access to exclusive events: Premium subscribers will get complimentary access to a selection of virtual & offline events. Manorama Online will be organizing exclusive events such as insightful webinars, live-stream, interactive talks with editors, and offline events based on the need of the hour for our premium subscribers.
  • Exclusive offers from Popular Brands: Access to exclusive coupon codes from popular brands to save big on favorite products and experiences
  • Exclusive News: Unlimited access to all exclusive content you need to know.
  • In-depth Reporting: Provides an in-depth analysis of topics and issues. With in-depth analysis of topics & issues, we make readers aware of all aspects of a published story by
  • giving them all possible credible information, including background and details.
  • Simple Content: Manorama Online aims to satisfy the needs of its customers by providing exclusive content presented in a simple, lucid and informative format.
  • Facts and Figures: We provide articles and stories with related facts and proven figures available from trusted sources.

As a 1-year premium + epaper subscriber, you can obtain your e-Paper access through the following steps:
  • You will receive a coupon code via email upon subscribing to the 1-year Manorama Online Premium subscription.
  • sit the e-Paper subscription page at https://epaper.manoramaonline.com/MMPortalUI/
  • Sign in to your account.
  • Elect your desired Indian edition and choose a 1-year subscription period.
  • Proceed to subscribe, which will take you to the Cart page.
  • Apply the coupon code provided in the Cart page.
  • The amount will be adjusted to reflect free access. Please note that the free e-Paper subscription is applicable only to Indian editions. International editions are not included in the package.
